title: Burning and Suppression of Solids II
objective_short: Study ignition, flame growth, flame spread, and extinction of solid fuels in low-velocity forced flow under microgravity.

title: Effect of External Thermo-Convective Perturbation on Cool Flame Dynamics: A Multidimensional Multi-Physics CFD Analysis
objective_short: Study how externally imposed thermal and convective perturbations affect established droplet cool flames using FLEX data and multidimensional CFD.

title: Smoke and Aerosol Measurement Experiment
objective_short: Measure smoke particle size distributions in microgravity and evaluate the response of spacecraft smoke detectors.
